filesToTouch.what: Complete the pp-007 skeleton to a full transposition of sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/import-type-filter/controller.js. Exports: `meta = { ...page, collects: ['importType'] }` (change from the skeleton's collects: []; importType is a FLOW_ONLY_KEY per FD-8 — the same shape live-animals uses, dispatch accepts it because flowOnlyKeys are injected via configureJourneyFlow), `PLANT_PRODUCTS = 'plants'`, `NOT_AVAILABLE_SLUG = 'import-type/not-available'`, `routes`. IMPORT_TYPES = ['live-animals','poao','hrfnao','plants'] house tokens (NOT the IPAFFS wire codes CVEDA/CVEDP/CED/CHEDPP — c-006-style normalisation) mapped to copy.importTypes labels. Validation: compose(requiredOneOf('importType', values, copy.errors.importTypeRequired)) from src/server/app/lib/validate/index.js — single Joi-voice string 'Select the type of import' (c-018), server-side only (no HTML required attribute; requiredOneOf also rejects crafted out-of-list values). render() builds kit.base(copy.title, { backLink: dashboardPath(), journeyId, recoverableError }) — REAL back-link href to the dashboard (fixes the IPAFFS href='#' defect) — plus copy, values, errors, kit.errorSummary(errors), importTypeOptions with checked-state. GET: state.get() once, prefill values.importType from answers (flow-only store rehydration). POST: validate → 400 re-render with raw value; kit.recoverableSave(() => state.commit(request, h, values), 500-re-render) ; on success, if values.importType !== PLANT_PRODUCTS redirect to pagePath(journeyId, NOT_AVAILABLE_SLUG); else opening-run branch verbatim from the exemplar: shouldOpenRun = inOpeningRun(request, journeyId) || !hasCommittedNotificationAnswers(answersBeforeCommit) (import from the set's flow/entry-guard.js, built by pp-009) → beginOpeningRun + h.redirect(kit.exitTarget(request, nextRunTarget(page.id, scope, journeyId))) (nextRunTarget from the set's flow/run.js); else kit.nextTarget(request, page, scope). getNotAvailable handler renders the holding view with backLink and changeAnswerHref both pagePath(journeyId, page.slug). routes = [...kit.pageRoutes(page, { get, post }), { method: 'GET', path: pageRoutePath(NOT_AVAILABLE_SLUG), options: kit.routeOptions, handler: getNotAvailable }]. BUILDER FAMILIES (§4.3, load-bearing under the /plant-products mount): the Hapi route table uses the PREFIX-FREE ROUTE-SHAPE builders (kit.pageRoutes calls pageRoutePath at module load; the not-available route path is pageRoutePath(NOT_AVAILABLE_SLUG)) and the mount comes from the plugin's routes.prefix — never hand-prefix a route path. Everything RENDERED or REDIRECTED TO uses the PREFIX-BEARING LINK builders evaluated per request: dashboardPath() for the back link, pagePath(journeyId, …) for the not-available redirect, the change-answer href and the back link on the holding page. Do NOT port the overdue-debtor gate, the debt disclosure partial, or any DoA/org-selection redirect (c-024; POST always advances per the above).

notes: Rationale: completes the pp-007 m0 import-type skeleton to the full CHED-PP entry filter. This is FLOW-ONLY work (FD-8): importType rides the plantProductsFlowOnlyAnswers session store, not the manifest — zero obligations, zero schema fields, zero flow-data edits (start section + RUN_STEPS + entry-guard all landed with pp-007/pp-009, FD-13). §8 G-H flags there is no flow-only recipe, so the plan is a verbatim transposition of the live-animals exemplar, verified live this session: sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/import-type-filter/{controller.js,template.njk,not-available.njk,copy/copy.en.js} (controller pattern: requiredOneOf validation, recoverableSave, non-matching type → NOT_AVAILABLE_SLUG, opening-run branch via beginOpeningRun/inOpeningRun/nextRunTarget/hasCommittedNotificationAnswers, exemplar dashboard create POST at features/dashboard/controller.js routes → records.create → redirect to import-type). Rulings applied: c-014 (legend-as-heading + caption, fixing the IPAFFS unnamed radio group), c-004 (shared 'There is a problem' error summary), c-018 (single Joi-voice string 'Select the type of import'), c-024 (overdue-debtor gate NOT ported — no disabled radio, no hint, no debt disclosure, no throw-on-POST). Decisions taken headless: (1) radio VALUES use the house tokens live-animals/poao/hrfnao/plants, not IPAFFS codes CVEDA/CVEDP/CED/CHEDPP — set-owned vocabulary, mirrors the sibling and the contract-test precedent; (2) LABELS use the CHED-PP page-spec wording verbatim (differs from the live-animals set's 'or' variants — each set owns its copy); (3) button label 'Save and continue' per the page spec (live-animals uses 'Continue'; the spec is canonical for this set); (4) legend sizing govuk-fieldset__legend--l per the house exemplar rather than IPAFFS's xl; (5) non-plants selections get a transposed not-available holding page (the plant set serves only CHED-PP — exact inverse of the live-animals filter); (6) ?source=dashboard dropped as vestigial. Sequencing: dependsOn is pp-007+pp-009 verbatim from MAPPING; the contract.plant-products.test.js edit assumes pp-010 (m0) has landed, which the milestone order guarantees — if running out of order, create the case when pp-010 lands instead. Axe checks live inside the co-located e2e spec per house convention (cheatsheet §1.10/§8).
